name: Document Loader: Media Library
description: Provides a reusable media library opener for Document Loader forms.
project_description: Document Loader: Media Library provides a reusable media-library opener service so the core media library can be embedded in Document Loader modal forms (MDXEditor, CKEditor, etc.) without an entity-reference field. When a user selects media, the opener writes the selected media IDs into a hidden field in the host form and triggers a hidden update button to AJAX-refresh the widget. Opener behaviour is configurable via the media-library state parameters (field_widget_id, dialog_selector).
